messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-04-02] standup/ember/2025-04-02: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-06-09] handover/2025-06-09-billing-api: The Ember team handed billing-api to Boreal today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Lena Fischer.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14: Rotation day for the Dune team: Tomasz hands the pager to Farah.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-3: Release captain for Q3 2025: Farah.
- [2026-04-14] standup/dune/2026-04-14-2: The Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-11-04] standup/ember/2025-11-04: The Ember team saw that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 following the marketing send; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-02-11] standup/atlas/2025-02-11: Reminder that the billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-04-07] standup/ember/2025-04-07: Per the change policy, the webhooks service deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC. Heads-up from the Ember team: the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01: Heads-up from Boreal: the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2026-04-13] standup/ember/2026-04-13-2: Ember still owns the reporting service, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for the billing API: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season).
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14: Observation from the Cinder team: after the cache change, webhooks' memory use grew steadily for a week.
- [2025-05-14] standup/cinder/2025-05-14-2: Cinder adopted trunk-based development.
- [2025-01-14] standup/atlas/2025-01-14: Reminder that Ledger only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-20] standup/dune/2025-01-20: The Dune team owns the image resizer.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the product catalog.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2: The Boreal team owns the notifier.
- [2025-09-05] standup/dune/2025-09-05: The Dune team still owns the scheduler, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-04-21] standup/dune/2025-04-21: The Dune team adopted a monthly game day.
- [2025-04-03] standup/atlas/2025-04-03: Reminder from team Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2025-08-15] standup/boreal/2025-08-15-2: Team Boreal still owns the bus, in case anyone asks.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: For the record, the webhook dispatcher is owned by team Boreal.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24: Rotation day for the Cinder team: Yuki hands the pager to Diego.
- [2025-03-20] handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer: Ownership change: the image resizer now sits with team Ember. Team Dune no longer owns it.
- [2025-04-24] standup/cinder/2025-04-24-2: Heads-up from the Cinder team: feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.
- [2025-01-20] standup/ember/2025-01-20: The job scheduler lives with the Ember team. For the record, the authentication gateway is owned by Ember.

Question: Which team owned billing-api on 2025-04-14?

message.reasoning:
The question asks which team owned billing-api on 2025-04-14.

Let me trace the ownership history:
- 2025-01-08: billing API lives with Atlas team
- 2025-03-07: Billing-api has a new home: Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today (2025-03-07).
- 2025-06-09: Ember handed billing-api to Boreal
- 2025-07-03: Correction: new owner of billing-api is Atlas, Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.

Wait, the 2025-07-03 correction says the new owner of billing-api is Atlas, correcting the 2025-06-09 handover which said Boreal. So the 2025-06-09 handover said Ember handed to Boreal, but the correction says the new owner is Atlas. Hmm, but does the correction mean that on 2025-06-09, Ember handed to Atlas (not Boreal)? Or does it mean something else?

The correction says: "Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it."

So the 2025-06-09 handover recorded Boreal as the new owner, but the correction says the new owner is Atlas. So after 2025-06-09, Atlas owns billing-api.

Then 2026-01-12: billing-api belongs to Ember team starting today.

So timeline:
- Until 2025-03-07: Atlas
- From 2025-03-07: Ember
- From 2025-06-09: Atlas (per correction, Boreal was a mistake)
- From 2026-01-12: Ember

On 2025-04-14: after 2025-03-07 handover to Ember, before 2025-06-09. So Ember owned billing-api on 2025-04-14.

Answer: Ember
